name: CodeElo (Codeforces Elo)
description: Competitive programming benchmark using 387 Codeforces problems with Elo ratings ranging from 0-3500, enabling human-comparable performance assessment of AI models on algorithmic challenges.
creator: Alibaba / Qwen team
notes: Top performance 1578 Elo (o1-mini). Elo scale is directly comparable to human competitive programmer ratings.
